theorem Roth.mul_log_div_two_lt_log_mainCoeffBound : ∀ {δ : ℝ} {q₁ r₁ : ℕ},
  2 ≤ ↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁) → δ * ↑r₁ * Real.log ↑q₁ / 2 < Real.log ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁) :=
fun {δ} {q₁ r₁} hX ↦
  id
    (Eq.mp
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg LT.lt
          (Eq.trans
            (Real.log_sqrt
              (le_of_lt
                (lt_of_lt_of_le
                  (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                    (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
                  hX)))
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                ((fun y ↦
                    Real.log_rpow
                      (Or.elim
                        ((Real.one_lt_rpow_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg q₁)).mp
                          (lt_of_lt_of_le
                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl false))
                            hX))
                        (fun h ↦ LT.lt.trans zero_lt_one h.left) And.left)
                      y)
                  (δ * ↑r₁)))
              2)))
        (Real.log ↑⌊↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)⌋₊))
      (Real.log_lt_log
        (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
          (lt_of_lt_of_le
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl false))
            hX))
        (Roth.sqrt_lt_floor hX).left))

LOG239_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {δ : ℝ} {q₁ r₁ : ℕ},
  2 ≤ ↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁) → δ * ↑r₁ * Real.log ↑q₁ / 2 < Real.log ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁)
